depiction.primary_object: circle with roughly three-eighths filled sector

readings.meaning: partial progress or completion status (three-eighths / ~37% full)

ambiguity: Virtually interchangeable with the five-eighths filled circle and the one-quarter filled circle for general pie chart or progress tasks; at a glance its 135-degree sector is very easily mistaken for the 90-degree quadrant of the one-quarter circle.

reasoning: Shows a circle with a filled 3/8 sector, which represents either a task progress indicator (UI state) or a pie chart / proportion. As a task subject it fits financial asset allocation, budget breakdowns, and data visualization charts, though it is less distinctive than a pie chart with an offset slice and can be mistaken for a clock or UI progress spinner.

pass1.ambiguity: Easily confused with a clock at ~12:20, a progress spinner UI indicator, or an Exposure/Contrast symbol.

distinguishing: Filled clockwise from 12 o'clock to 4:30 (three-eighths or 37.5%), making it larger than a quarter but less than half full, though for general pie chart or progress meanings it is interchangeable with the five-eighths and one-quarter circles.
